newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Santos says finds new Otway Basin gas field.
newsitem.headline: Santos says finds new Otway Basin gas field.

text.p: Operator Santos Ltd said on Tuesday that it had cased and suspended the Fenton Creek One wildcat well in the onshore Victorian section of the Otway Basin as a future gas producer in a new-field discovery.
The well flowed six million cubic feet of gas per day and 43 barrels per day of condensate from a drill stem test in reservoir sands between 1,574 metres and 1,584 metres.
Santos and Cultus Petroleum NL each have a 50 percent stake in the well, located in permit PEP 108. The well was the first operated by Santos in the Otway Basin.
